scalars.scalar_value: The position typically requires a Bachelor’s degree in business, human resources, or related discipline and five years of experience in a human resources function. Or, any combination of education and experience which would provide the required equivalent qualifications for the position.

items.item_text: 01. Please select the option which best describes your years of human resources experience: Options: Less than 1 year | 1 to less than 3 years | 3 to less than 5 years | 5 or more years

02. Please select all areas in which you have experience in a technical human resources function. Experience should be within a Human Resources Office/Department. Options: Recruitment | Equal Employment Opportunity and Diversity | Employment Services (onboarding and offboarding) | Benefits Administration | Classification and Compensation | Professional Development | HR Systems/HRIS
03. Please describe your overall experience in all areas selected in Question 2 and include where you gained your experience.

04. Please describe your work experience in an education setting or public agency. Include your experience with Memorandum of Understandings (MOU), Government and/or Education Codes, or other policies and procedures.

05. Describe your skill level using software programs, including Human Resources Information Systems and applicant tracking systems (i.e. NEOGOV/NEOED). Include the name of each program and your level of expertise with each.

06. Please describe your experience coordinating and administering recruitment processes from job posting through selection. Include your experience with activities such as applicant screening, interview coordination, candidate communications, recruitment tracking systems, developing recruitment timelines, and ensuring compliance with employment laws, policies, or equal employment opportunity requirements. Please identify where you gained this experience.

07. I understand that a COMPLETE application packet is required for consideration, which includes the following: 1. A completed Coast Community College District Online Employment Application 2. A current resume (uploaded as a separate attachment - PDF recommended) 3. A cover letter (uploaded as a separate attachment - PDF recommended) 4. Responses to supplemental questions (clear and detailed responses required as they will be carefully evaluated to determine the most qualified candidate(s) to be invited for an interview; please do not paste your resume, or put "see resume", or "N/A" or leave blank) Options: Yes | No
May require a valid driver license.

The position typically requires a Bachelor’s degree in business, human resources, or related discipline and five years of experience in a human resources function. Or, any combination of education and experience which would provide the required equivalent qualifications for the position.

Demonstrated evidence of responsiveness to and understanding of the racial, ethnic, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, socioeconomic, academic, and cultural diversity within the community college student population, including students with different ability statuses (e.g., physical and/or learning) as these factors relate to the need for equity-minded practice within the classroom and campus.
